interpretation: Scientific negative/constraint result, not a pipeline failure. Live C1.h5 normalization passed the reviewed M3D-C1 Alfven-time calibration, but the authoritative 8.376 ms Mirnov/toroidal precursor lead and 3.0 ms bounded-boost response budget map far outside the current native characterization window (0.05 to 0.14 solver units). The controller matrix therefore did not execute and bounded boost correctly remained NO ACTION; zero-equivalence is not applicable because the contract requires it only if the controller matrix executes. Frozen gates remain unchanged at width_gain_pct > +0.020% and Jpk_change_pct <= +0.10%. Claim boundary remains normalized native M3D-C1 only; no reactor-scale or experimental stabilization claim.
follow_up_decision: No new job queued from this result. Extending the native run by the ~10^4 solver-time units implied by experimental millisecond timing would not be a focused or computationally justified follow-up, and clipping/inventing trigger times would violate the timing contract.
